en.title: Companies Regulations s.26(4): the fine clause was not updated when Amendments No. 4 moved the annual-return deadline and contents into a new subsection (1-1)
en.summary: Amendments No. 4 moved the annual-return deadline and contents from section 26(1) of the Companies Regulations into a new subsection (1-1). Section 26(4) still makes "subsection (1), (2-1) or (3)" punishable by a fine, and item 10 of Schedule 3 of the Companies Rules still says "26(1) or (3)". The reference to (1) may be read as reaching the re-enacted duty (section 21(2) of the AIFC Regulations on AIFC Acts), but a reader of section 26(4) cannot see that late or incomplete filing is finable. Item 10 also does not list subsection (2-1), which section 26(4) makes finable.
en.correction: Please consider amending section 26(4) to read "subsection (1), (1-1), (2-1) or (3)", and please align item 10 of Schedule 3 of the Companies Rules, which also omits (2-1).
